abstract.t: The adoption of network operation automation has brought new measurement methodology requirements. Among them is the ability to collect the instant network operational state as the packet is being processed by the network elements along its forwarding path through a network domain. That requirement can be addressed by using on-path telemetry, also called hybrid performance measurement according to RFC 7799. An on-path telemetry method allows operators to collect key information that reflects the operational state and the network performance a packet experiences through the forwarding path. IOAM, defined in RFC 9197 and RFC 9326, is an example of such a hybrid method. This document introduces a method complementary to on-path telemetry that causes the generation of network telemetry information. This document introduces Hybrid Two-Step (HTS), a method complementary to both passive and hybrid measurement approaches. HTS separates measuring or calculating the performance metric from collecting and transporting network operational state.
